_about: TA's scripted conversation. These answers are instant, free and can't hallucinate, so they cover the questions visitors ask most. Free-form questions go to the LLM. Actions: next (go to node), track (set hiring track), open (case study slug), email, ask (open the text box), dismiss.

start.say: Hi! I'm TA, Taylor's teaching assistant. What brings you here today?

start_preset._note: Shown when a preset link is used. {greeting} comes from the preset or the track default.

hiring.say: Great. What are you hiring for? I'll put the most relevant work first.

track_enablement.say: Taylor designs education that changes what people do, then measures it. A good place to start: the Academy redesign, where short courses now finish about twice as often as long ones.

track_content.say: Taylor builds content systems people can find and use. For example, a centralized in-app resource center was followed by a 45% year-over-year drop in reporting-related support cases.

track_ai.say: Taylor builds governed AI content pipelines with a human approval at every stage. Course turnaround dropped from six or more weeks to three or fewer. I'm part of this work too: Taylor built me.

impact.say:
A few highlights:
• New orgs reaching the onboarding success milestone: ~40% → 75%
• Intelligent Ask Amounts adoption: ~20% → 75%+ in a year
• Course turnaround with AI pipelines: 6+ weeks → 3 or fewer

onboarding.say: Taylor built a scaled onboarding program on the Academy: milestone-based learning paths, short video lessons, and connected in-app and email touchpoints. The share of new organizations reaching the success milestone rose from about 40% to 75%.

docs.say: Taylor writes for developers and admins alike: the GoFundMe Pro webhooks guide and API docs, payments docs for GoFundMe Pay (which runs on Stripe), and a docs-as-code help center for beta features.

background.say: Before tech, Taylor taught history in Brooklyn and led lesson plan writing for Uncommon Schools: a remote learning system of 200+ lesson plans across 50 schools, and a modular framework that cut lesson creation from 4 hours to 90 minutes. That's where the teaching instincts come from. Mine too.

how_ta_works.say: I answer from Taylor's case studies and resume, my "lesson plans." Common questions like these get scripted answers. Anything else goes to a small AI model that's only allowed to use those lesson plans, and I show which files each answer came from.

contact.say: The best way to reach Taylor is email.

fallback._note: Used when the LLM is off (kill switch), over its limits, or errors.
fallback.say: I can only answer my usual questions right now. Pick one below, or ask Taylor directly.

dismiss.say: I'll be at my desk if you need me.
